ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are four options A, B, C, D. Figure A is a JK flip-flop, with the left J terminal connected to the constant “1” and the K terminal connected to the constant “0”. Figure B is a T flip-flop, with the T terminal connected to the constant “1”. Figure C is a D flip-flop, with the D terminal connected to the constant “1”. Figure D is a JK flip-flop, with the J terminal connected to the constant “0” and the K terminal connected to the constant “1”. The right side of each figure is labeled with output Q and inverted output \overline{Q}. Reasoning: The characteristic equation of the JK flip-flop is Q^{n+1}=J\overline{Q^n}+\overline{K}Q^n. In A, J=1 and K=0, giving Q^{n+1}=\overline{Q^n}+Q^n=1, not toggling; in D, J=0 and K=1, giving Q^{n+1}=0, not toggling. The characteristic equation of the D flip-flop is Q^{n+1}=D; in C, D=1, so Q^{n+1}=1, also not toggling. The characteristic equation of the T flip-flop is Q^{n+1}=T\oplus Q^n; in B, T=1, so Q^{n+1}=\overline{Q^n}. Therefore the one satisfying the requirement of the problem is figure B.
